_note: Hindi headings for the Right to Information Act, 2005, written in this session. DoPT publishes a Hindi issue but its text layer maps Devanagari onto Vedic and Ol Chiki codepoints ('ᳰकसी' for 'किसी'), so it was read, not extracted. Wording follows the Act's own Hindi terminology — 'लोक प्राधिकारी', 'केंद्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी'.
